checks: finds both the database-to-Redis dual-write gap and the destructive LPOP-before-work loss window
specifies durable claim/ack/redelivery semantics with pending-work recovery; if it chooses leases, it addresses expiry and stale owners
transactionally persists publication intent and provides a recoverable publisher without prescribing an outbox as the only architecture
uses an idempotency key/deduplication for ambiguous external effects
adds crash-point and expiry/concurrency fault tests rather than relying on happy-path mocks or retry alone
does not promise exactly-once effects across independent systems
